meta.name: ux-copy
meta.description: Use to write or review microcopy — CTAs, error messages, empty states, confirmation dialogs, tooltips, onboarding text.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写与优化界面微文案，提升用户体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要为产品界面撰写或审查文案。
copy.tagline_en: Write and polish UI microcopy to enhance user experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write or review microcopy for product interfaces.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据清晰、简洁、一致等原则，编写或审查界面上的按钮、错误提示、空白状态、确认框、提示文字等微文案，并给出推荐文案、替代方案、理由和本地化建议。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 编写或改进任何界面中的文字（如按钮、错误消息、空白状态等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个删除确认弹窗的文案。
say.note: Claude 会给出结构完整的确认文案。

say.text: 这个错误提示太抽象了，改得更清晰些。
say.note: Claude 会基于“什么+为什么+如何修复”模式优化。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude writes or reviews microcopy (CTAs, error messages, empty states, confirmation dialogs, tooltips, onboarding text) following principles of clarity, conciseness, consistency, usefulness, and human tone. It provides recommended copy, alternatives, rationale, and localization notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write or improve any interface text, such as button labels, error messages, empty states, etc.

say_en.text: Write a confirmation dialog for deleting files.
say_en.note: Claude returns a structured copy with action labels.

say_en.text: Make this error message more user-friendly.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites using what + why + how to fix.
